body:
maria: quick question — we keep getting requests on how to surface routing degradations to clients. when we route to a cheaper/quantized variant due to quota/capacity, should we return 200 + a header, or a non-2xx code so SDKs can show a banner?
ben: my 2c: return 200 for functional success. add a header like `x-rw-degrade: quota` so consoles can react. avoid turning success into errors.
nash: (we don't have a Nash in participants; ignore)
ashley: customers asked for explicit signal though. mobile teams want a single field, not to parse headers.
katie: what if SDKs expose a `client_status` field on the response object (string enum)? it would work across platforms. header still useful for raw HTTP users.
oliver: enum could be `ok | degraded_quota | degraded_capacity | fallback_model | partial`. keep it small.
maria: agree with enum. separate out HTTP error mapping rules for real errors: 429 = client throttle/quota exceeded, 503 = infra/service capacity, 507 = tenant quota full? we need to decide.
ben: 507 (insufficient storage) is weird semantically. i'd avoid inventing new 5xx unless standard fits. maybe use 429 for client-level limits, 503 for any server-side capacity/backpressure.
nash (not in list)
ashley: counterpoint — products asked for a distinct code when the request *succeeds* but was downgraded (so they can count degraded responses easily in logs). we could keep 200 and a numeric `x-rw-status-level: 0|1|2` but that's ugly.
katie: Proposal (v1):
- success (no issues): HTTP 200, client_status: `ok`
- downgraded but successful: HTTP 200, client_status: `degraded_quota` or `degraded_capacity`, header `x-rw-client-status` set the same
- client exceeded quotas (hard reject): HTTP 429, body {"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after": 60} + telemetry tag `signal.quota.hard_reject`
- transient infra pressure (we can't serve): HTTP 503, body {"error":"service_unavailable","retry_after": 30} + telemetry tag `signal.infra.backpressure`

ben: looks fine. SDKs should treat `client_status` !== `ok` as something to surface in UI but still keep the payload.
oliver: two extra asks: 1) include `x-rw-route-variant` header for debugging (but only on debug builds or when `X-RW-Debug: 1` to avoid leaking implementation). 2) telemetry should include `route.variant` and `route.reason` tags.
maria: agree on conditional variant header. privacy/regulatory customers might not want variant info in responses. so default off.
ashley: console UX: we need a mapping table that says which client_status values cause: banner (critical vs info), badge color, rollout bucket metrics. i'll mock it.
katie: also add a `rw_degrade_score` float [0.0-1.0] in telemetry for ranking incidents. not in response body.
ben: implementation note — runtime can detect capacity vs quota by looking at budget vs global capacity. route reason enum: `quota`, `capacity`, `policy` (e.g., pinned model mismatch).

Example HTTP response for downgraded success:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
x-rw-client-status: degraded_quota
x-rw-route-variant: quantized-8bit  # only when X-RW-Debug=1
x-rw-degrade-reason: quota

{ "id":"req_123", "client_status":"degraded_quota", "choices": [...] }
```

maria: example for hard quota reject:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
content-type: application/json
retry-after: 60

{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "message": "Tenant exceeded monthly generation quota", "retry_after": 60 }
```

oliver: telemetry example (high level): `trace.tags = {"signal":"quota.hard_reject","route.variant":"quantized-8bit","route.reason":"quota"}`

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T22:05Z: feature/status-client-status staged to `canary` (sha: c1a2b3) :rocket:

ashley: nice. a couple of edgecases: streaming responses where we switch variant mid-stream (we do this for fallbacks). how do we signal mid-stream? chunk header? final metadata?
katie: streaming: header `x-rw-client-status` at start + final event with `__rw_status_update` message in the stream when it changes. SDKs should surface the latest.
ben: also, SDK error mapping: if we return 200 with `degraded_*`, SDKs should increment a metric `client_degradation.count` and surface a telemetry event.
maria: action items: 1) i'll write API contract PR with `client_status` enum + header rules (PR by EOW). 2) @katie please add telemetry tags + degrade_score. 3) @ashley mock console mapping and banner rules. 4) @ben update SDKs to expose `client_status` and increment metrics.
maria: anyone opposed?
ashley: nope :thumbsup:
ben: +1
oliver: +1
katie: i'll start a telemetry RFC draft.
devops-bot: note: rollback button present if canary error rate > 2% for 5m

maria: thanks all — will open PRs and link back here.
